prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in your insured's file. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical care. We are gathering the documentation needed to present a full claim on their behalf.

Please provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any communications with your insured or other parties. Please suspend any routine destruction of these materials until the claim is resolved.

Kindly confirm receipt of this letter and your preservation commitment in writing.
